items.question: Why should I choose Quantum Overseas for my immigration and study abroad needs?
items.answer: Quantum Overseas is a premier, transparent, and result-oriented overseas consultancy. With over 15 years of industry leadership, 98% visa success rate, partnerships with 500+ global universities, certified counselors, and end-to-end support (from coaching to post-landing), we make your international journey smooth and stress-free.

items.question: What is the typical timeline for receiving a student visa or PR visa?
items.answer: Student visas typically take between 2 to 6 weeks after submission depending on the country (e.g., UK Priority is 5-7 days, Canada SDS is 3-4 weeks, USA is granted immediately upon interview). Permanent Residency (PR) processing varies from 6 to 12 months for Express Entry and 8 to 14 months for Australian GSM.

items.question: Do you offer free profile evaluation?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a 100% free, comprehensive profile evaluation where our senior immigration advisors assess your qualifications, work experience, financial standing, and language scores to recommend the best pathway.

items.question: Can I study abroad without IELTS?
items.answer: Yes! Several top universities in the UK, Europe, Dubai, and USA accept students without IELTS if you scored 65%+ in Class 12th English, hold a Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from an English-medium university, or pass the university's internal English test/PTE/Duolingo.

items.question: Are international students allowed to work while studying?
items.answer: Yes. Most countries (UK, Canada, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, USA on-campus) permit international students to work part-time (up to 20 to 24 hours per week) during semester terms and full-time (40 hours per week) during holidays and scheduled breaks.

items.question: What are Post-Study Work (PSW) visa options available?
items.answer: The UK offers a 2-year Graduate Route, Canada provides up to 3-year PGWP, Australia offers 2 to 4+ years 485 Temporary Graduate Visa, New Zealand provides 3-year post-study work visa, and USA provides up to 3 years STEM OPT.

items.question: How long are the IELTS and PTE coaching batches at Quantum Overseas?
items.answer: Our comprehensive IELTS/PTE course runs for 8 to 12 weeks. We also offer an intensive 4-week fast-track crash course for quick exam takers and retakers. Both weekday and weekend batches are available in online and offline modes.

items.question: Are mock tests included in the coaching program?
items.answer: Yes, students receive unlimited access to full-length computer-delivered mock tests, authentic exam simulation software, personalized 1-on-1 speaking interviews with trainers, and detailed writing task evaluations.

items.question: What documents are most important for visitor visa approvals?
items.answer: The most critical elements are strong financial capability (bank statements, ITRs), clear purpose of visit, confirmed travel itinerary, invitation letter (if visiting family/friends), and strong evidence of ties to India (property, employment, business, family) showing you will return before visa expiry.

items.question: Can I convert my visitor visa to a work visa or student visa?
items.answer: Certain countries (like Canada, UAE, New Zealand) have policies allowing visitor visa holders with a valid job offer or university admission to apply for a work permit or study permit inside the country without returning home.
